newsitem.title: MEXICO: CIE issues 250 mln pesos in debt.
newsitem.headline: CIE issues 250 mln pesos in debt.

text.p: Mexico's Corporacion Interamericana de Entretenimiento SA (CIE) will issue some 250 million pesos in mandatorily convertible debt on June 6, lead manager GBM Atlantico said on Wednesday.
The debt, worth 100 pesos per unit, will have a two-year maturity and pay 12 percent annual return twice a year.
Upon maturity, the debt will be converted to shares at a price of 40 pesos per share. Debtholders can also convert the debt to shares after just one year.

If the share price during the 15 days prior to maturity is less than 40 pesos per B share, the company will pay debtholders an additional four pesos per share, or an additional 10 percent, the company said.
